The Bespoke Journey
An immersive 48-hour weekend buyout from Friday settle-in through Sunday farewell. One wedding, forty acres, midnight curfew. Time is the luxury.
The Weekend
Friday. Settle in. Arrive at leisure, explore the forty acres, welcome dinner on the grounds.
Saturday. Celebrate. Ceremony where you choose, cocktails on the water, dance until midnight on your private estate.
Sunday. Linger. Coffee on the chalet porch, slow goodbyes. The buyout is still yours until farewell.
Arrival: Chicago O'Hare and Milwaukee Mitchell are about one hour. Lake Geneva corridor stays and Harvard, Illinois 60033 on I-90 and Route 47.

Friday porch light warms the gravel lane as you arrive at leisure. Three spring-fed ponds sit quiet under towering oaks, and dogs wander unhurried beside you. This is forty acres held solely for your people from noon to departure.

Many couples capture engagement photos near Lake Geneva on our grounds before they reserve their weekend. Sessions are scheduled separately by appointment. Bring your photographer or ask for our insured partner list. The buyout makes the whole estate yours when you are ready.
